description: Use before writing or fixing ditaa ASCII-art diagrams for render_diagram (format ditaa): column alignment, colour and shape tags, rounded corners, worked examples, identifier rule.
identifier: This language cannot separate a key from a label: the text you draw is the only name. Draw the display name, put the identifier in the text only when the reader needs it (for example `n0002 engine`). Never invent identifiers.

examples.name: two boxes joined by a vertical arrow
